title: [R3] Optimistic messages lost when EventSource calls renderThread
description:
Race condition in message compose:
1. User sends message → appendMessageBubble(optimistic) at line 458 (temp bubble added to DOM)
2. EventSource state event arrives with new messages for current chat
3. Handler calls fetchMessages() at line 554 → renderThread() at line 333
4. renderThread() does div.innerHTML = '' (line 384), clearing entire thread
5. Optimistic bubble is lost (never replaced with real server response)
6. User sees: message sent, then immediately disappears, then reappears from server

Symptoms: Flickering/lost messages on send during concurrent state updates.

Fix: Merge incoming messages with optimistic messages rather than wholesale thread replacement. Check for temp-prefixed IDs (line 448) before clearing.
notes: opinion: cannotCalculateChanges triggers only on server-side state compaction; at MVP scale with 2 users on tailnet this is unreachable; optimistic bubble loss is theoretical
